title: Write about your day
description: Short writing about routines and food.

items.prompt: Write 3–4 sentences about your typical day.
items.promptIt: Scrivi 3–4 frasi sulla tua giornata tipo.

items.prompt: Write two sentences: one food you like and one you don't like.
items.promptIt: Scrivi due frasi: un cibo che ti piace e uno che non ti piace.
